criteria.text: A disabled-by-default, bounded stable cohort can run shadow retrieval only after a genuine Tier 1 exit, without changing the returned lesson context or required-RAG outcome.

Each sampled shadow run records one content-free tier1_shadow trace with an unthresholded raw dense Tier 1 maximum score, exact active-hybrid Tier 2 result count, false-positive classification, configured rate, and completion/failure metadata.
Invalid or absent rollout rates fail closed, tenant/course/evidence filters are preserved in every shadow query, and deterministic unit tests plus type-check and build pass without a live experiment.
